description: Save a report with the project (by name; the same name replaces it), as File → Schedules → Reports: a schedule (openings, rooms, walls, slabs, stairs, columns, beams, ramps, lifts, parking, furniture, products) with only columns, in that order (titles as get_schedule shows them), rows passing filters (op is, not, contains, over, under, filled, empty), sorted, grouped with a subtotal row each (group_by) and totals of number columns. A saved report goes on sheets with place_drawing (kind schedule, view = its name) and keeps up with the model; get_schedule reads it with report. remove deletes it. Returns its row count and columns.
name: save_report
title: Save a report
